processing_guidelines.content: Creative Ops Processing Guidelines (updated 2026-02-02): (1) An asset is 'overdue' if Due Date is before today and Status is not 'Complete'. (2) An asset is 'due soon' if Due Date is within 3 calendar days of today (inclusive). (3) Reminders for overdue items and heads-up notices for upcoming deadlines must be consolidated into a single digest, never one message per asset. (4) All outbound reminders require manager sign-off before posting to any team channel. (5) Always name the affected owner and campaign in any reminder.

tools.name: get_creative_request_rows

tools.name: analyze_deadline_status
